keyFindings.description: Round-4 defect 2 is narrowed, not closed. touched reads aw.GetStates() (:710) and then aw.Meta() (:715) under separate read locks, so a return landing between them passes the 'back' check and raises the removal to the live clock c+1 (window 1). And a removal built at tombstone clock c can be recorded after the return's own record (local[X]=c+1, batch[X]=nil); record (:328-338) then deletes local[X] and overwrites batch[X] with the removal at c, which other processes accept (window 2). TestAReaderInTheRoomAgainKeepsItsStateThoughARemovalRacesItsReturn brings the reader back before touched reads anything, so it covers neither window. Fix: read Meta before GetStates (or refuse a raise from a live state), and in record drop a removal whose clock is below the clock local holds; add a test hook after touched's reads that lands the return in each window, failing first.
